subject: Copywriting
title: Writing for Vulnerable Audiences
description: A 60-second lesson on Writing for Vulnerable Audiences.

hook.text: Payday loan ads target people in financial distress. Children see 40,000 ads per year.

buildup.text: Copy targeting the elderly, the grieving, or the desperate amplifies harm. Vulnerability increases persuasion's power.

discovery.text: The UK banned junk food ads during children's TV. Gambling disclaimers became mandatory. Regulation caught up.

twist.text: Digital targeting makes vulnerability easier to exploit. Algorithms find desperate people better than humans ever could.

climax.text: Responsible copy considers who will read it, not just who should. The audience's vulnerability shapes the ethics.

punchline.text: Power to persuade means duty to protect. Know your reader.

quiz.question: Why is targeting vulnerable audiences an ethical concern?
options: Vulnerability increases persuasion's power and potential for harm
